# Generated by ppc worldbuilder from the World Builder handover; do not edit by hand.

# Improvement building level caps: base + attribute class terms + levels per development point x development.

# The equation (<key>_terms, or <group or key>_shared for buildings sharing a cap) is named unlabelled, so the

# max-level tooltip lists its rows; a shared cap subtracts the other members' levels. Clamp and member rows show

# only where they change the value.

pp_wb_cap_land_clearance = {
	add = pp_wb_cap_land_clearance_terms
	if = { limit = { pp_wb_cap_land_clearance_terms > 15 } max = { desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_MAXIMUM" value = 15 } }
}

	value = development
	multiply = 0.03

pp_wb_cap_field_management = {
	add = pp_wb_cap_field_management_shared
	if = { limit = { pp_wb_cap_field_management_shared > 15 } max = { desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_MAXIMUM" value = 15 } }
	if = { limit = { modifier:pp_wb_levels_field_management_convertible > 0 } subtract = { desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_SHARED_FIELD_MANAGEMENT_CONVERTIBLE" value = modifier:pp_wb_levels_field_management_convertible } }
	if = { limit = { modifier:pp_wb_levels_field_management_improved > 0 } subtract = { desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_SHARED_FIELD_MANAGEMENT_IMPROVED" value = modifier:pp_wb_levels_field_management_improved } }
	if = { limit = { modifier:pp_wb_levels_jiangnan_hill_terraces > 0 } subtract = { desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_SHARED_JIANGNAN_HILL_TERRACES" value = modifier:pp_wb_levels_jiangnan_hill_terraces } }
	if = { limit = { OR = { modifier:pp_wb_levels_field_management_convertible > 0 modifier:pp_wb_levels_field_management_improved > 0 modifier:pp_wb_levels_jiangnan_hill_terraces > 0 } pp_wb_cap_field_management_open < 0 } min = { desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_MINIMUM" value = 0 } }
}

pp_wb_cap_field_management_open = {
	value = pp_wb_cap_field_management_shared
	max = 15
	subtract = modifier:pp_wb_levels_field_management_convertible
	subtract = modifier:pp_wb_levels_field_management_improved
	subtract = modifier:pp_wb_levels_jiangnan_hill_terraces
}

	value = development
	multiply = 0.02

pp_wb_cap_irrigation_systems = {
	add = pp_wb_cap_water_control_shared
	if = { limit = { development > 500 pp_wb_cap_water_control_shared > 15 } max = { desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_MAXIMUM" value = 15 } }
	if = { limit = { modifier:pp_wb_levels_qanats > 0 } subtract = { desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_SHARED_QANATS" value = modifier:pp_wb_levels_qanats } }
	if = { limit = { modifier:pp_wb_levels_bund > 0 } subtract = { desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_SHARED_BUND" value = modifier:pp_wb_levels_bund } }
	if = { limit = { modifier:pp_wb_levels_field_drainage > 0 } subtract = { desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_SHARED_FIELD_DRAINAGE" value = modifier:pp_wb_levels_field_drainage } }
	if = { limit = { modifier:pp_wb_levels_polders > 0 } subtract = { desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_SHARED_POLDERS" value = modifier:pp_wb_levels_polders } }
	if = { limit = { modifier:pp_wb_levels_khmer_baray > 0 } subtract = { desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_SHARED_KHMER_BARAY" value = modifier:pp_wb_levels_khmer_baray } }
	if = { limit = { modifier:pp_wb_levels_incamisana > 0 } subtract = { desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_SHARED_INCAMISANA" value = modifier:pp_wb_levels_incamisana } }
	if = { limit = { OR = { modifier:pp_wb_levels_qanats > 0 modifier:pp_wb_levels_bund > 0 modifier:pp_wb_levels_field_drainage > 0 modifier:pp_wb_levels_polders > 0 modifier:pp_wb_levels_khmer_baray > 0 modifier:pp_wb_levels_incamisana > 0 } pp_wb_cap_irrigation_systems_open < 0 } min = { desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_MINIMUM" value = 0 } }
}

pp_wb_cap_irrigation_systems_open = {
	value = pp_wb_cap_water_control_shared
	max = 15
	subtract = modifier:pp_wb_levels_qanats
	subtract = modifier:pp_wb_levels_bund
	subtract = modifier:pp_wb_levels_field_drainage
	subtract = modifier:pp_wb_levels_polders
	subtract = modifier:pp_wb_levels_khmer_baray
	subtract = modifier:pp_wb_levels_incamisana
}

	subtract = modifier:pp_wb_levels_qanats

	if = { limit = { development > 500 pp_wb_cap_water_control_shared > 15 } max = { desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_MAXIMUM" value = 15 } }
	if = { limit = { modifier:pp_wb_levels_irrigation_systems > 0 } subtract = { desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_SHARED_IRRIGATION_SYSTEMS" value = modifier:pp_wb_levels_irrigation_systems } }
	if = { limit = { modifier:pp_wb_levels_qanats > 0 } subtract = { desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_SHARED_QANATS" value = modifier:pp_wb_levels_qanats } }

pp_wb_cap_irrigated_fields = {
	add = pp_wb_cap_irrigated_fields_terms

}

pp_wb_cap_irrigated_fields_terms = {
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_BASE"
		value = 5
	}
	if = {
		limit = { climate = arctic }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_CLIMATE_ARCTIC"
			value = 3
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { climate = arid }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_CLIMATE_ARID"
			value = 3
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { climate = cold_arid }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_CLIMATE_COLD_ARID"
			value = 3
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { climate = cold_semi_arid }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_CLIMATE_COLD_SEMI_ARID"
			value = 3
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { climate = ha1300_climate_dry_summer_continental }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_CLIMATE_DRY_SUMMER_CONTINENTAL"
			value = 3
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { climate = hot_semi_arid }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_CLIMATE_HOT_SEMI_ARID"
			value = 3
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { climate = mediterranean }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_CLIMATE_MEDITERRANEAN"
			value = 3
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { climate = oceanic }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_CLIMATE_OCEANIC"
			value = 3
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { climate = ha1300_climate_savanna }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_CLIMATE_SAVANNA"
			value = 1
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { climate = subpolar }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_CLIMATE_SUBPOLAR"
			value = 3
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { climate = ha1300_climate_subpolar_oceanic }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_CLIMATE_SUBPOLAR_OCEANIC"
			value = 3
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { climate = subtropical }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_CLIMATE_SUBTROPICAL"
			value = 3
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { climate = ha1300_climate_subtropical_monsoon }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_CLIMATE_SUBTROPICAL_MONSOON"
			value = 1
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { climate = tropical }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_CLIMATE_TROPICAL"
			value = 3
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { climate = ha1300_climate_tropical_monsoon }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_CLIMATE_TROPICAL_MONSOON"
			value = 3
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { topography = atoll }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_TOPOGRAPHY_ATOLL"
			value = 2
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { topography = ha1300_topo_deltas }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_TOPOGRAPHY_DELTAS"
			value = 2
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { topography = ha1300_topo_floodplains }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_TOPOGRAPHY_FLOODPLAINS"
			value = 1
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { topography = hills }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_TOPOGRAPHY_HILLS"
			value = -3
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { topography = mountain_wasteland }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_TOPOGRAPHY_MOUNTAIN_WASTELAND"
			value = 2
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { topography = mountains }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_TOPOGRAPHY_MOUNTAINS"
			value = 2
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { topography = plateau }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_TOPOGRAPHY_PLATEAU"
			value = -2
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { topography = ha1300_topo_rolling }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_TOPOGRAPHY_ROLLING"
			value = 2
		}

		limit = { topography = ha1300_topo_valleys }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_TOPOGRAPHY_VALLEYS"
			value = -1
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { topography = wetlands }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_TOPOGRAPHY_WETLANDS"
			value = 1
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { vegetation = ha1300_veg_coniferous_forest }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_VEGETATION_CONIFEROUS_FOREST"
			value = -1
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { vegetation = desert }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_VEGETATION_DESERT"
			value = 4
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { vegetation = ha1300_veg_dry_forest }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_VEGETATION_DRY_FOREST"
			value = 1
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { vegetation = farmland }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_VEGETATION_FARMLAND"
			value = 4
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { vegetation = jungle }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_VEGETATION_JUNGLE"
			value = 4
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { vegetation = ha1300_veg_marsh }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_VEGETATION_MARSH"
			value = 4
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { vegetation = ha1300_veg_mixed_forest }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_VEGETATION_MIXED_FOREST"
			value = 2
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { vegetation = ha1300_veg_savanna }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_VEGETATION_SAVANNA"
			value = 4
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { vegetation = ha1300_veg_scrubland }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_VEGETATION_SCRUBLAND"
			value = -1
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { vegetation = sparse }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_VEGETATION_SPARSE"
			value = 4
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { vegetation = ha1300_veg_swamp }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_VEGETATION_SWAMP"
			value = 4
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { vegetation = ha1300_veg_thicket }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_VEGETATION_THICKET"
			value = -1
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { vegetation = ha1300_veg_tundra }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_VEGETATION_TUNDRA"
			value = 4
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { vegetation = woods }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_VEGETATION_WOODS"
			value = 4
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_location_modifier = pp_wb_fertility_high }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_FERTILITY_HIGH"
			value = 1
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_location_modifier = pp_wb_fertility_low }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_FERTILITY_LOW"
			value = -1
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_location_modifier = pp_wb_fertility_very_high }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_FERTILITY_VERY_HIGH"
			value = 1
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_location_modifier = pp_wb_fertility_very_low }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_FERTILITY_VERY_LOW"
			value = -1
		}
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_DEVELOPMENT"
		value = this.pp_wb_cap_irrigated_fields_terms_building_level_wb_development
	}
}

# Tooltip helpers of pp_wb_cap_irrigated_fields_terms (cap_tooltips.py): each is one row of the cap, read through this.
pp_wb_cap_irrigated_fields_terms_building_level_wb_development = {
	value = development
	multiply = 0.05
}

		limit = { climate = ha1300_climate_tropical_monsoon }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_CLIMATE_TROPICAL_MONSOON"
			value = 3
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { topography = atoll }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_TOPOGRAPHY_ATOLL"
			value = 2
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { topography = ha1300_topo_deltas }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_TOPOGRAPHY_DELTAS"
			value = 2
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { topography = ha1300_topo_floodplains }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_TOPOGRAPHY_FLOODPLAINS"
			value = 1
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { topography = hills }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_TOPOGRAPHY_HILLS"
			value = -3
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { topography = mountain_wasteland }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_TOPOGRAPHY_MOUNTAIN_WASTELAND"
			value = 2
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { topography = mountains }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_TOPOGRAPHY_MOUNTAINS"
			value = 2
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { topography = plateau }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_TOPOGRAPHY_PLATEAU"
			value = -2
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { topography = ha1300_topo_rolling }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_TOPOGRAPHY_ROLLING"
			value = 2
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { topography = ha1300_topo_valleys }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_TOPOGRAPHY_VALLEYS"
			value = -1
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { topography = wetlands }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_TOPOGRAPHY_WETLANDS"
			value = 1
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { vegetation = ha1300_veg_coniferous_forest }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_VEGETATION_CONIFEROUS_FOREST"
			value = -1
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { vegetation = desert }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_VEGETATION_DESERT"
			value = 4
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { vegetation = ha1300_veg_dry_forest }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_VEGETATION_DRY_FOREST"
			value = 1
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { vegetation = farmland }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_VEGETATION_FARMLAND"
			value = 4
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { vegetation = jungle }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_VEGETATION_JUNGLE"
			value = 4
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { vegetation = ha1300_veg_marsh }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_VEGETATION_MARSH"
			value = 4
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { vegetation = ha1300_veg_mixed_forest }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_VEGETATION_MIXED_FOREST"
			value = 2
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { vegetation = ha1300_veg_savanna }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_VEGETATION_SAVANNA"
			value = 4
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { vegetation = ha1300_veg_scrubland }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_VEGETATION_SCRUBLAND"
			value = -1
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { vegetation = sparse }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_VEGETATION_SPARSE"
			value = 4
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { vegetation = ha1300_veg_swamp }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_VEGETATION_SWAMP"
			value = 4
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { vegetation = ha1300_veg_thicket }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_VEGETATION_THICKET"
			value = -1
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { vegetation = ha1300_veg_tundra }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_VEGETATION_TUNDRA"
			value = 4
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { vegetation = woods }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_VEGETATION_WOODS"
			value = 4
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_location_modifier = pp_wb_fertility_high }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_FERTILITY_HIGH"
			value = 1
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_location_modifier = pp_wb_fertility_low }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_FERTILITY_LOW"
			value = -1
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_location_modifier = pp_wb_fertility_very_high }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_FERTILITY_VERY_HIGH"
			value = 1
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_location_modifier = pp_wb_fertility_very_low }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_FERTILITY_VERY_LOW"
			value = -1
		}
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_DEVELOPMENT"
		value = this.pp_wb_cap_paddy_water_control_shared_building_level_wb_development
	}
}

# Tooltip helpers of pp_wb_cap_paddy_water_control_shared (cap_tooltips.py): each is one row of the cap, read through this.
pp_wb_cap_paddy_water_control_shared_building_level_wb_development = {
	value = development
	multiply = 0.05
}

pp_wb_cap_paddy_water_control = {
	add = pp_wb_cap_paddy_water_control_shared
	if = { limit = { pp_wb_cap_paddy_water_control_shared > 15 } max = { desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_MAXIMUM" value = 15 } }
	if = { limit = { modifier:pp_wb_levels_jiangnan_canal_network > 0 } subtract = { desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_SHARED_JIANGNAN_CANAL_NETWORK" value = modifier:pp_wb_levels_jiangnan_canal_network } }
	if = { limit = { OR = { modifier:pp_wb_levels_jiangnan_canal_network > 0 } pp_wb_cap_paddy_water_control_open < 0 } min = { desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_MINIMUM" value = 0 } }
}

pp_wb_cap_paddy_water_control_open = {
	value = pp_wb_cap_paddy_water_control_shared
	max = 15
	subtract = modifier:pp_wb_levels_jiangnan_canal_network
}

pp_wb_cap_jiangnan_canal_network = {
	add = pp_wb_cap_paddy_water_control_shared
	if = { limit = { pp_wb_cap_paddy_water_control_shared > 15 } max = { desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_MAXIMUM" value = 15 } }
	if = { limit = { modifier:pp_wb_levels_paddy_water_control > 0 } subtract = { desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_SHARED_PADDY_WATER_CONTROL" value = modifier:pp_wb_levels_paddy_water_control } }
	if = { limit = { OR = { modifier:pp_wb_levels_paddy_water_control > 0 } pp_wb_cap_jiangnan_canal_network_open < 0 } min = { desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_MINIMUM" value = 0 } }
}

pp_wb_cap_jiangnan_canal_network_open = {
	value = pp_wb_cap_paddy_water_control_shared
	max = 15
	subtract = modifier:pp_wb_levels_paddy_water_control
}
